Subject: Security scope confirmation & incident-notification timelines — next steps

Hi Laura / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — great conversation. As promised, a short recap and proposed next steps so your procurement and security teams have what they need to move forward.

Quick recap (from our call)
- Primary concern: SOC 2 posture, HIPAA applicability for PHI in a monitored subset of logs, and breach-notification SLA for regulated incidents.
- Scope question: which environments would host PHI (hosted API vs. private deployment)? You indicated production data will be in us-east for now.

What we will deliver next (proposed)
1) SOC 2 summary (attachment) — high-level report extract and list of covered services.
2) Completed vendor questionnaire tailored to Novara (we can pre-fill answers and mark anything that needs legal review).
3) IR/BCP artifacts: IR runbook extract, most recent DR exercise summary.
4) Contractual items: we can start a BAA and confirm breach-notification timing in the SOW.

Suggested incident-notification cadence (we propose — happy to align to your procurement standard)
- Initial notification: within 24 hours of detection if incident affects customer data or meets your regulatory thresholds.
- Preliminary containment update: within 48–72 hours with scope estimate.
- Formal incident report: within 72 hours if required by law/regulation, with a remediation plan and timelines (usually follow-ups at 7/30/90 days as required).

Next steps I suggest:
- Please confirm whether Novara requires SOC 2 Type II and a signed BAA upfront.
- Attach your vendor questionnaire (if you have one) — I took the liberty of attaching a blank copy so we can pre-fill.
- If agreeable, schedule a 30-min security sync with Neha (CC'd) to walk through the IR/BCP artifacts and sign-off path.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, novara-security-questionnaire.docx

I'll hold on the pre-filled questionnaire until I hear whether you prefer answers from engineering/security or legal first.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao

Thanks, Aditya — helpful summary. A few clarifications from procurement/security side:

1) SOC 2 expectation: Novara requires SOC 2 Type II covering Security + Availability. We will also need evidence of the last year of control monitoring (summary is fine).
2) HIPAA/PHI: We expect either (a) a signed BAA or (b) confirmation that PHI will not be processed in hosted environments. For our initial POC, Novara may share limited PHI for testing purposes, so we need a BAA in place.
3) Breach notification SLA: procurement is asking for initial notification within 48 hours and an update within 72 hours. Legal may push 24 hours in certain data-breach scenarios — we need to know your standard practice.
4) Evidence requested: incident response playbook (redacted is ok), latest DR test summary for last 12 months, and any runbook snapshots you can share.

Attached: Novara_Security_Q.docx (our standard questionnaire) — please pre-fill where possible.

Would also like a link to your SOC 2 report or an NDA process to receive the full attestation. Can you confirm timeline to provide the requested artifacts? Procurement needs them prior to the next approval meeting on 2026-09-30.

Laura Chen
Head of Vendor Risk & Compliance | Novara Health

Laura — thanks for the quick feedback and the questionnaire. Quick answers and next-step commitments below.

SOC 2 / NDA / BAA
- SOC 2 Type II: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II (Security + Availability) audit in 2025; a shareable summary is attached and we can provide the full report under NDA.
- BAA: Redwood executes BAAs for customers processing PHI on hosted or private deployments. I can start the BAA flow; legal prefers DocuSign for execution.

Incident-notification timing
- Our standard contractual cadence: initial notification within 24 hours of confirmed material impact, updates every 24 hours while active, and a formal report within 72 hours if regulatory thresholds are met.
- We can align the contract to Novara's procurement ask of initial notification in 48 hours if that is non-negotiable, but operationally we treat detection as urgent and will notify earlier when appropriate.

Requested evidence and delivery timeline
- We will: pre-fill your questionnaire and return within 3 business days (attachment: vendor-questionnaire-completed-novara.pdf).
- Share an IR runbook extract and DR exercise summary (attachments).
- Provide a secure link for SOC 2 report access once NDA is signed.

SOC 2 and attestation

The full report is provided under NDA; a redacted summary is attached (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). If Novara prefers, we can provide evidence via our secure report portal (link below) after an NDA.

BAA and PHI handling

IR / BCP specifics
- Incident notification: our operational practice is to send an initial notification within 24 hours of confirmed material impact, then updates every 24 hours until containment. For contracts we can map to 48-hour procurement requirements but will still notify earlier in practice when detection is certain.
- DR testing: we run quarterly DR / failover exercises; last full DR exercise affecting customer-facing control plane was 2026-06-10. Summary (redacted) attached.

Artifacts we will provide (timeline)
- IR runbook extract: immediate (attached ir-playbook-extract.txt).
- DR exercise summary: immediate (attached dr-exercise-summary-20260610.pdf).
- Completed Novara questionnaire: 3 business days as Aditya noted.
